purpose: Read-only verification of Universaarl starter account visibility in the Chart of Accounts before Master Data, VAT write, Posting Group write or process work continues.
businessPurpose: A Business Central consultant needs to know whether the minimal Universaarl starter accounts are actually visible in the Kontenplan before using them in setup, training, UAT or book examples.

smartDecision.whyNow: TARGET-075 proved Chart of Accounts visibility but did not visibly prove the starter accounts needed by later setup and training examples.
smartDecision.whyThisRoute: The Kontenplan is a materially different, low-risk read-first gap from Page 314 and Page 472 editor blockers.
smartDecision.fallback: If the account list cannot be proven read-only, keep Master Data parked and update Foundation Readiness with a Chart of Accounts visibility blocker.

provedMustSay: which starter accounts are absent or not proven
notProvedMustSay: no complete SKR04 chart of accounts

stopIf: Business Central is not in playthru
Chart of Accounts page is not visibly proven
a dialog asks to create, edit, suggest, import, apply, confirm or change setup
the run would require account creation/editing or any write action
trainingImpact: Supports Finance and Key User training by showing whether the starter accounts used in later examples are visible in the Kontenplan.
bookImpact: Can support a beginner-facing explanation of checking the chart of accounts before using account numbers in posting setup or process examples, but only as read-first evidence.
